source_extracts.label: USA PATRIOT Act CIP rule
source_extracts.quote: 31 CFR 1020.220 — banks must collect a residential or business street address for each customer under the Customer Identification Program rules; a PO box alone does not satisfy the requirement.

source_extracts.label: IRS Form SS-4 instructions
source_extracts.quote: Form SS-4 (EIN application), street address line: 'Don't enter a P.O. box.' Form 1040 permits a PO box as mailing address where the post office does not deliver to the home.

source_extracts.label: Ohio BMV acceptable documents / residence address
source_extracts.quote: Ohio BMV requires the residence address (not a PO box) and two documents from different sources proving an Ohio street address.

source_extracts.label: Ohio statutory agent rules
source_extracts.quote: Ohio Secretary of State: every Ohio LLC/Corporation must maintain a statutory agent whose address is a street address in Ohio where someone is present during business hours — a PO box or mailbox number does not qualify.

source_extracts.label: USPS DMM 508 — PO Box delivery
source_extracts.quote: Only the USPS delivers to PO Boxes; private carriers (UPS, FedEx, DHL) cannot deliver to a post office box.
